description.value: Mui Garden is a Malaysian-Chinese restaurant with roots in Hong Kong, known for authentic Malaysian curry blended from over twenty spices and Hainanese-style chicken in two preparations — free range and farm chicken. The Kingsway location is one of four Metro Vancouver outposts of the chain, offering a full dine-in menu spanning Singaporean laksa, curry beef brisket, and fried rice dishes. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down meal option with online ordering also available for takeout.
